description: This file contains unit tests for the Goteo"Text" library, including methods to test language translation retrieval, parameter substitution, and translation consistency across different languages.

classes.name: TextTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Goteo\, Text library and translation functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes language translator and loads translation keys before each test.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Verifies that the Text class can be instantiated.

methods.name: testLang
methods.description: Checks that the translation for 'test-lang-1' matches the expected string.

methods.name: testLangOldParams
methods.description: Tests translation retrieval with old parameter passing style.

methods.name: testLangParams
methods.description: Tests translation retrieval with parameter substitution including named variables.

methods.name: testGet
methods.description: Tests the get method of the Text class for multiple translation scenarios.

methods.name: testLangTranslations
methods.description: Verifies consistency of translation strings across different languages, checking for variable presence and HTML tags.
